proof_body:
by
  intro a b x y ha hb
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hnorm : ‖(⟨x / a, y / b⟩ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_mk, show x / a * (x / a) + y / b * (y / b) = 1 by rw [← h]; ring, Real.sqrt_one]
    refine ⟨Complex.arg ⟨x / a, y / b⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨x / a, y / b⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnorm, one_mul] at this
      simp only at this
      rw [this]; field_simp
    · have := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨x / a, y / b⟩ : ℂ)
      rw [hnorm, one_mul] at this
      simp only at this
      rw [this]; field_simp
  · rintro ⟨θ, rfl, rfl⟩
    have : (a * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 / a ^ 2 + (b * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 / b ^ 2 = Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    rw [this, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
target_source: ∀ (a b x y : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → (x ^ 2 / a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 / b ^ 2 = 1 ↔ ∃ θ : ℝ, x = a * Real.cos θ ∧ y = b * Real.sin θ)
